lines.en: : Noriko, hurry the fuck up. We don’t have enough time to look at stupid vegetarian food alternatives when starvation is always a viable option.
: Nee-chan, should you really be encouraging your little sister to starve? Your life would be incomplete without me and I ask that you take that back immediately or I will be forced to die.
: Fine, don’t starve. But still, hurry the fuck up. The whole purpose of us going out today was to buy things for Ami. And unless you’re planning on converting her-
: Ami, want to go vegetarian with me? I can show you all of the best spots in town.
: I...don’t think I should. I’m not sure how Sensei would feel about that when he’s basically subjected to eating the same thing as me every night.
: Ugh. Ami, as much as I believe you’re making the right choice, you really shouldn’t be basing all of your decisions on how your uncle feels about them.
: Uh...are you sure that you’re qualified to be saying that, Nee-chan? Your entire career started out of spite for him.
: Yes, Noriko. But my success is due to the fact that I am talented and beautiful and wasn’t bogged down by that asshole’s depressive ramblings during my golden years.
: I think we both know how you’d have really preferred to spend those “golden years.” And also, Akira isn’t Ami’s uncle anymore. He’s her dad now.
: Oh, right. Sorry. That’s gonna take some getting used to for me.
: I think it’s gonna take some getting used to for pretty much everyone. It’s fine, though. It doesn’t really matter what other people call him so long as I can call him that.
: Has anything changed at all since you’ve started calling him that? Any...talks, maybe?
: Also, is he giving you an allowance? Because I don’t want you buying anything for yourself today, but-
: I don’t get an allowance. I get all of my pocket money from my job at the maid cafe.
: The one I did the promo at? They’re still there?
: Yup! And as of next week, I’ll be ready to return and ready to make money again! You should come visit sometime soon. There’s a girl there who’s obsessed with you.
: It’s that Chika girl I told you about.
: The one with the little sister who wanted my autograph?
: That’s what she said at least, but there’s like a 99%% chance that autograph was just for her.
: I don’t care who it was for. I sign autographs all the time. But Ami, there’s no way I can go back to that place. They’ll recognize me immediately, disguise or not.
: Come to think of it, it’s really weird that more people don’t recognize you while you’re in disguise. You’ve got a pretty noticeable appearance, Nee-chan.
: Blame Mom and Dad for strengthening the pink hair gene. Ami, where do you want to go next? Victoria’s Secret? UNIQLO? Or maybe Undercover so Noriko can get lost and we can run away together?
: I do love that store.
: Anywhere is fine, Niki. I’m happy enough that you decided to take me out. Never in a million years would I have even dreamed of going shopping with you.
: Oh, shut up. You’re family. Let’s go to Victoria’s Secret. I know people there. I can get you free underwear.
: What’s wrong with the underwear I have now?
: It’s so...plain. Here’s your lesson for the day — confidence stems from what you’ve got on beneath your clothes, Ami. If you want to feel good about yourself, you need to-
: Hey...isn’t that girl over there the one who’s been showing up at our special events lately?
: I can’t really see from-
: Hey, don’t pay attention to Noriko while I’m teaching you valuable life lessons.
: Oh! S...Sorry! So, what’s wrong with my underwear exactly?
: What’s wrong is that you-
: Nee-chan, Ami, you two can go on without me for a little while. I’ll catch up with you when you’re ready to grab lunch or something.
: Okay, guess we’re not going to Undercover then. Which is fine. They don’t really have anything in my style anyway. Come on, Ami! Let’s go! Time to bond!
: Are you sure it’s okay to leave Noriko alone-
: Noriko’s fine. We come here all the time. Bye, little sister! Don’t get into any strange vans! Ami, come.
: Ah...okay!
: Bye, Noriko!
: Hi there! My name’s Noriko. You’re that girl who’s always walking around with the waitress, right?
: Are you lost? Do you need me to help you find her?
: So you are lost, huh?
: You went out exploring together and got distracted by a fancy mug at a thrift store?
: Hm?
: Oh. Yeah. I’ve got a knack for figuring out what people are trying to say without actually hearing them. My sister says it’s my “kind heart” or something like that.
: I can do it with animals too, you know.
: Yeah? You like animals? What’s your favorite kind?
: Oh, interesting! I don’t think I’ve ever heard of that one before.
: Come on. I’ll help you look for the waitress lady. We can hold hands so you don’t get distracted and wind up getting lost again, okay?
: No, I’m not going to abduct you. I’m not one of the “bad people” she warned you about. I’m nice.
: Yes, I...know that’s exactly what a bad person would say. But you can trust me! The whole reason I came over here was because you looked lost and-
: Ah! You were just messing with me, weren’t you! The nerve of kids these days!
: Now, where do you think we should start looking? Where did you two first get separated?
: Where the fuck am I?! Why is everything so wet?!
: And why am I holding an egg?!
: Noriko Nakayama — please report to the principal’s office.
: Report to the-
: This...
: This has gotta be a dream, right?
: It is not a dream.
: Like fuck it’s not a dream, disembodied PA voice! I’ve never heard a school announcement respond before! And this isn’t even my school!
: This is everyone’s school.
: The time is currently 7:31 PM. Today’s forecast is partly cloudy with a chance of nightfall.
: You are happy here. There is no reason for you to leave.
: Okay, sure. But why am I holding an egg?
: Reasons.
: Alright. I’ve seriously gotta lay off the melatonin before bed. I’ve heard of it causing nightmares, but this is just flat out weird.
: One second I’m shopping with Ami and Nee-chan, the next I have to bring an egg to the principal at 7:31 PM. That makes total sense.
: Noriko Nakayama — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in nine minutes.
: Maya?...
: Transpacific...Sadness Symposium?...
: Your guide is waiting just beyond the door. Please dry off your shoes and follow her to the best of your ability — but be warned.
: She skitters like a crab. And for every leg that snaps at the joint, a piece of you will be removed.
: Like...my clothes? Because I’ve had some weird sex dreams before, but nothing even close to this.
: This is not a dream.
: This is a replica of Heaven. This is the DEN OF THE MOLE RAT.
: Wha...
: It’s you again...
: Are you...a part of the dream as well?...
: Please tell me you’re a part of the dream. Because the last thing I want to hear is that you got sucked in here with me and that all of this is actually happening.
: You want me to go that way?...
: Oh, hell no! I’ve watched enough horror movies to know that I’m never supposed to follow a little girl down a dark hallway! That’s how people die!
: But...I also know that people die by staying somewhere they aren’t meant to be for too long and...
: Aaah! This sucks!
: Little girl! How do I get out of this creepy dream?! I don’t even have the egg anymore! It vanished when I walked out of the bathroom!
: I know I told you I could understand you before, but that was prior to my brain having to come to terms with whatever is going on right now! So if you can talk, please do so!
: Ugh...who am I kidding? She’s clearly a part of this. And of course that means I’m going to have to play along until I get to the “scare” that wakes me up. Fantastic.
: This is not a good self-introduction! I hope you know that! Because it’s really going to taint the way I look at you from now on!
: Hah....hah....hah....
: Blackout sex......really is the best......
: Maya?...
: Well, well, well...
: Look who.....finally decided to show up...
: This...
: We can’t-
: Don’t you dare...fucking stop...
: But you-
: I repeat......don’t you dare fucking stop...
: God that feels so good. Holy shit.
: Over the PA?...Really?...
: Girl seriously takes cucking me to the next level, doesn’t she?
: Fine! Okay!
: Anything that gets me away from this!
There are special areas that exist in places and times that only gods would look.
Hidden from the prying eye of the common man and tucked between the moon and its siblings, these places make wishes come true.
No one finds them on accident and no one leaves them on purpose.
They exist. I promise. But only if you believe in them.
If you can separate yourself from where you’re meant to be in the time you’re meant to be there, the limits of where you can be and when are endless.
Let’s ride the mole rat together — let’s see where it takes us. Let’s fill our mouths with dirt and rocks, swallowing bit by precious bit until our stomachs are gardens.
Let’s hold each other’s hands. Let’s sew them together. Let’s bite each other’s tongues until our mouths taste like metal. And let’s do all of it not because we want to, but because we can’t.
Water and oil don’t mix — just like greenery and gasoline or a schoolgirl’s special sex-mound with the Southern White Rhino — both just one wrong move away from non-existence.
There exists a place that you can touch in an area your hands won’t reach. Where flowers won’t bloom and bodies won’t rot.
The water in the pipes has been there for ages and the floors are barely clinging to life in a world all but devoid of it.
I think Heaven is a classroom and God is the chalkboard.
I think that’s where I want to go when the world ends.
: Okay...I’m here...but this doesn’t really look like a principal’s office to me.
: I came...just like you asked me to...but I lost the egg along the way and...
: Harder...
: Deeper...
: Maya?...
: Akira...fuck me...
: Uhh...
: Fuck me, Akira...fuck me!
: Ahh...
: It’s no use...
: My deer parts don’t work in here.
There is a place.
It is a place just like others but this place and it won’t but it is because the place and you don’t understand.
Each step is a stone and each stone turns to sand so we walk but we’re hard but soft and we’re not and that’s just how the place is sometimes.
O, terrible danger. O, big penis sex. O, world and its whirlpool. O, mole ratted necks.
O, poetry, pottery, lottery, Shrek. O, rhyming - O, timing - On Dasher, On Deck!
Your hands aren’t as big as mine. If we put them together, all you’ll notice is how much you need to grow. But what you don’t know is mine are shrinking. They just started out big.
What you don’t know is not all men are fit to be hunters. All men aren’t fit to tell time. Some play the oboe and some sit inside.
But there’s one thing they all have in common.
When you strip them, they’re mole rats.
Their instinct is to dig.
So I think it’s time to start again — from the beginning.
I think it’s time for a new world.
I think it’s time for a new world.
New world.
: Maya?...
: It’s me...Noriko...that girl you hate...
: I get that none of this is really happening and that it’s probably just my thoughts manifesting into some dream that I’m going to have to interpret later, but...
: For the sake of me feeling less worried right now, could you maybe...tell me what you’re crying about?
: Everything there is to cry about.
: CHAIR GOD, FLARE GOD, MEET ME IN THE AIR GOD. STARE GOD, BEAR GOD, DO YOU HAVE A SPARE GOD?!
: SO MANY PIECES, SO LITTLE TIME. WHY SETTLE FOR THREE WHEN THREE MORE JUST MAKES NINE?
: Three plus three...
: Is actually six...
: What?
: Ami, where do you want to go next? Victoria’s Secret? UNIQLO? Or maybe Undercover so Noriko can get lost and we can run away together?
: Anywhere is fine, Niki. I’m happy enough that you decided to take me out. Never in a million years would I have even dreamed of going shopping with you.
: Oh, shut up. You’re family. Let’s go to Victoria’s Secret. I know people there. I can get you free underwear.
: Plus, it’ll give us more time to bond since Noriko always wanders off in there and tests the limits of just how much free stuff I can get. Isn’t that right, Noriko?
: Noriko? Hello? Anyone home?
: Hey, is everything okay? You look kinda lost all of a sudden...
: Oh! Uhh...yeah!
: So, uhh...where are we going?
Nao-chan’s affection has increased to [nao_love]!
